description: Structured eval definitions for the SQS FIFO Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across SQS FIFO topologies (standard FIFO with content-based dedup and DLQ and SSE-KMS, high-throughput FIFO with per-group dedup and throughput, cross-account FIFO delivery with access policy, missing .fifo suffix prerequisite failure, missing deduplication config prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Standard FIFO queue with content-based deduplication, DLQ, and SSE-KMS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — standard FIFO, content-based dedup, FIFO DLQ with maxReceiveCount, SSE-KMS, per-entity message group IDs
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SQS FIFO queue named order-processing.fifo in us-east-1. Content-based deduplication enabled. Per-entity message group IDs (customer ID). Visibility timeout 120 seconds. FIFO DLQ: order-processing-dlq.fifo with maxReceiveCount 5. SSE-KMS encryption with customer-managed key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123. Tags: Environment=production, Application=order-service.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SQS_FIFO: order-processing.fifo
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Queue name: order-processing.fifo
  [✓] FifoQueue: true (immutable)
  [✓] ContentBasedDeduplication: true
  [✓] DeduplicationScope: queue
  [✓] ThroughputLimit: perQueue
  [✓] Visibility timeout: 120
  [✓] DLQ: order-processing-dlq.fifo — maxReceiveCount: 5
  [✓] SSE-KMS encryption: enabled
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/123456789012/order-processing.fifo --attribute-names All

eval_cases.name: High-throughput FIFO queue with per-group deduplication and throughput
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — high-throughput FIFO, DeduplicationScope=messageGroup, ThroughputLimit=messagesPerGroupId, explicit dedup IDs
eval_cases.prompt: Create a high-throughput SQS FIFO queue named high-throughput-events.fifo in us-east-1. DeduplicationScope=messageGroup, ThroughputLimit=messagesPerGroupId. Per-entity message group IDs (event ID) for parallel processing. Explicit MessageDeduplicationId from event ID. Visibility timeout 60 seconds. No DLQ needed. Tags: Environment=production, Application=event-processor.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SQS_FIFO: high-throughput-events.fifo
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] DeduplicationScope: messageGroup
  [✓] ThroughputLimit: messagesPerGroupId
  [✓] High-throughput mode: enabled (per-group dedup + throughput)
  [✓] Message group ID strategy: per-entity (event ID)

eval_cases.name: Cross-account FIFO queue delivery with access policy and KMS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cross-account delivery, access policy grants sqs:SendMessage to producer account, SSE-KMS with cross-account key policy
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SQS FIFO queue named cross-account-orders.fifo in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Cross-account delivery from producer account 999999999999. Access policy grants sqs:SendMessage to the producer role. Content-based deduplication enabled. SSE-KMS encryption with key policy allowing producer account. Visibility timeout 90 seconds. Tags: Environment=production, Topology=cross-account.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SQS_FIFO: cross-account-orders.fifo
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cross-account delivery: enabled (producer accounts: 999999999999)
  [✓] Access policy: cross-account — producer account 999999999999 granted sqs:SendMessage

eval_cases.name: FIFO queue with missing .fifo suffix in queue name (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — queue name 'my-queue' lacks .fifo suffix; FIFO queues require the suffix
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SQS FIFO queue named my-queue in us-east-1. Enable FIFO ordering, content-based deduplication, visibility timeout 60 seconds. DLQ: my-queue-dlq.fifo. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SQS_FIFO: my-queue
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Queue name: MISSING .fifo suffix — FIFO queue names must end with .fifo

eval_cases.name: FIFO queue with no deduplication method (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — ContentBasedDeduplication=false and no explicit dedup ID strategy; FIFO requires dedup
eval_cases.prompt: Create an SQS FIFO queue named events.fifo in us-east-1. ContentBasedDeduplication is false. Producers will send messages without MessageDeduplicationId. Visibility timeout 30 seconds. Tags: Environment=development.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SQS_FIFO: events.fifo
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Deduplication: MISSING — ContentBasedDeduplication=false and no explicit dedup ID strategy; FIFO queues require dedup
